title: How AI Can Write an Almost Meaningful Research Article
subject: Research & Scholarship
excerpt: Generative AI can produce polished academic prose in seconds. But fluent writing is not the same thing as knowledge. A reflection on how researchers can leverage AI without surrendering the human responsibility behind meaningful scholarship.
